summary: Merged the 42-entry existing summary patch and 8 new story/choice proposals; runtime catalog, localized text, stories and notes are the maintained sources. Proposal JSON is research history, not an alternative runtime source.

refinements.change: Move availability checks and part-material caveats out of the lead; keep specific feather shapes, hand-dyed fabric, metallic thread and open loops first. Existing purchase/parts details stay in the canonical fields.

Remove the stale-cache discussion from the public tax note and duplicate numeric price from material notes. Current numeric Japan price remains only in the canonical price field; the research records retain the fresh 22000 and rejected cached 20000 evidence.
Remove an obsolete 18K explanation for a withdrawn product from the current regional choice guide.
Independent copy review caught an unsupported synthetic-leather backing assignment; the product researcher corrected the proposal to the confirmed list of cotton and synthetic leather before merging.

limits: Baseline and exact-copy checks do not establish semantic originality or factual truth. Product research and human review remain separate; no use, wear, test, sales, SEO or approval claim was added.
